## Tutorials

The TimeSerial() function returns a time from the specified parts (hour, minute, and second value).

### Code Examples

```
SELECT TimeSerial(15, 9, 20);

---

TimeSerial(
hour
,
minute
,
second
)

---

SELECT TimeSerial(12-2, 40-5, 20-5);
```

## Tutorials

The TimeValue() function returns a time based on a string.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT TimeValue("17:15:38");

---

TimeValue(
string
)

---

SELECT TimeValue("5:15:38 PM");
```

## Tutorials

The Weekday() function returns the weekday number for a given date.

This function returns an integer between 1 and 7.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Weekday(#05/17/2017#);

---

Weekday(
date
,
firstdayofweek
)

---

SELECT Weekday(Date());

---

SELECT Weekday(#05/17/2017#, 2);
```

## Tutorials

The WeekdayName() function returns the weekday name based on a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT WeekdayName(3);

---

WeekdayName(
number
,
abbreviate
,
firstdayofweek
)

---

SELECT WeekdayName(3, true);

---

SELECT WeekdayName(3, true, 2);
```

## Tutorials

The Year() function returns the year part of a given date.

This function returns an integer between 100 and 9999.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Year(#05/17/2017#);

---

Year(
date
)

---

SELECT Year(Date());

---

SELECT Year(BirthDate) FROM Employees;
```
